entities.summary: Maxim Olegovich Mayorov is an Uzbekistani-born Russian former ice hockey player. He played 22 games in the National Hockey League with the Columbus Blue Jackets between 2008 and 2012. The rest of his career, which lasted from 2005 to 2021, was mainly spent in the Kontinental Hockey League.
